description: This file contains unit tests for the ChatLog component, verifying its behavior in various scenarios such as message management, pruning, rendering, and state reconciliation.

classes.name: ChatLog
classes.description: A class representing a chat log component with methods for managing messages, rendering, and state updates.

methods.name: addSystem
methods.description: Adds a system message to the chat log.

methods.name: startAssistant
methods.description: Starts an assistant message thread with provided name and run ID.

methods.name: updateAssistant
methods.description: Updates an assistant message thread with a new name and run ID.

methods.name: addUser
methods.description: Adds a user message to the chat log.

methods.name: addPendingUser
methods.description: Adds a pending user message with an optional timestamp.

methods.name: restorePendingUsers
methods.description: Restores pending user messages from saved state.

methods.name: commitPendingUser
methods.description: Marks a pending user message as committed.

methods.name: countPendingUsers
methods.description: Returns the number of pending user messages.

methods.name: clearAll
methods.description: Clears all messages, optionally preserving pending users.

methods.name: reconcilePendingUsers
methods.description: Reconciles pending users against recent history using timestamps.

methods.name: showBtw
methods.description: Displays a 'behind the scenes' (BTW) message overlay.

methods.name: hasVisibleBtw
methods.description: Checks if a BTW overlay is currently visible.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the chat log, returning an array of strings representing the messages.
